subject: handling of '?' in a markdown document

messages.author: 4184023bb084c468
messages.subject: handling of '?' in a markdown document
parts:
Hi,

I have a markdown document containing the following:

```{r eval=FALSE}
?ls
```

When I knit this (after setting render_markdown(strict=TRUE)), I get:

    `?`(ls)

I'd like it to just render as:

    ?ls

Any tips for doing so?

Thanks,
Dan

If you don't need knitr to evaluate the block, why not just use a normal markdown codeblock instead?


This will be evaluated, which is not what I want.

Maybe you mean:

    ?ls

OK, that's a workaround. But I'd still like to know why knitr changes ?ls to `?`(ls) and if there is a way to suppress it. 

Thanks,
Dan
